messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: set fig.path etc based on script name?
parts:
Can I access the name of the script being knitted from within a chunk?

e.g. in order that when I do `knit("myscript.Rmd") that I could also set something like `opts_chunk$set(fig.path=gsub(".Rmd", "", filename))` where `filename="myscript.Rmd"` ?
